verdict.rationale: Apple's spec page documents the external connectivity well: three Thunderbolt 5 ports (up to 120Gb/s) with USB4, DisplayPort and charging, plus support for up to four external displays including HDMI 4K@144Hz. That is enough to plan a dock or display setup around. However, the pack has no PCIe generation or lane documentation and no internal storage speed specs, so half of the I/O headroom story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: PCIe generation/lane counts, SSD throughput specs, independent or hands-on corroboration of Thunderbolt 5 bandwidth.
